titre_page: How to use phone tilt and shake? | Yop2D guide
description: In Yop2D your phone can drive the game: read the tilt in a formula, move a character by tilting, roll a marble and react to a shake.
h1: How to use phone tilt and shake?
carte: Move a character, roll a marble or throw a die by shaking the phone.
etapes: “Tilting the phone” group in the left panel.
Realistic physics → “Marble: rolls when you tilt the phone” box.
blocs: p

Your phone knows when you tilt or shake it. Yop2D lets you use that **without writing code**: a character that walks when you tilt, a marble that rolls through a maze, a die that rolls when you shake.
besoin
a project open in the editor;
a phone or tablet: the sensor is the device's own.
h2
Step 1: read the tilt in a formula
bloc
ol
Open a node that has a formula field, for example [[modifier_propriete]].
In the left panel, open the **Tilting the phone** group.
Tap **inclinaison.x** (left-right) or **inclinaison.y** (top-bottom of the screen): the formula writes itself.
tip

Values go from -1 to 1. **0** = the way you held your phone when the game started; **1** = fully tilted (about 30°) to the right for x, toward the bottom of the screen for y. It works in portrait and landscape.
h2
Step 2: a character that walks when you tilt
bloc
ol
Pick your character, then tap **Object behavior** in the Inspector.
Choose a platform character or a top-down character.
On the **Controls** line, tap **Tilt**.
Set the **Sensitivity**: gentle, normal or strong.
For a platform character, add a jump button: tilting does not make it jump.
p
The “Move by tilting” template shows all this ready to use.
h2
Step 3: a rolling marble
bloc
ol
Create a round object (a marble picture or a colored circle).
Tap **Object behavior**, then **Realistic physics**.
Tick **Marble: rolls when you tilt the phone**. Yop2D sets the round shape, the bounce and the gravity for you.
Add walls: objects with the same behavior, set to **Fixed**.
If the marble is too fast or too slow, change the **Sensitivity**.
p
The “Marble maze” template has a marble, walls, black holes that restart the level and a green circle to reach.
h2
Step 4: react to a shake
bloc
ol
In the Blueprint, add the [[lang:noeud_event_secousse]] event.
Connect it to whatever you want: shuffle, roll a die, knock objects down…
Shake your phone: it takes **two quick, sharp jolts**. A simple move is not enough, and one second of rest is enforced between two shakes.
p
The “Shake to roll the die” template writes a random number, random(1, 6), in a die's text on every shake.
h2
Reset the tilt to zero
p
The zero is the phone's position when the game starts. To redo it (the player changes posture, new level), add the [[recalibrer_inclinaison]] node.
ul
**The screen does not rotate:** when a game uses tilt, the screen stays in its starting position, otherwise it would flip while you tilt.
**Device without a sensor:** the value stays at 0 and nothing moves.
